report.verdict: Cobalt Pay is hiring an engineering manager, and your resume shows a senior engineer rather than a people manager. Your payments and backend work is strong, but I can't tell whether you've managed engineers directly.
write_up: For Cobalt Pay, the main gap is the move from senior engineering to people management. Your Tidewater work shows substantial payments and platform engineering, but it doesn't establish the direct-report experience this role asks for.

The CI pipeline line is a great model: it names the templates, the tool and the change in build time. Your payment failover result is equally strong, but a recruiter reaches it after several unrelated office and volunteer activities.

Lead with the payments and production work, and make room by trimming activities that aren't relevant to this posting. If you've managed engineers, add what you can substantiate about that work; otherwise, your resume is strong for senior engineering roles, while this manager role asks for a different track.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Platform, CI pipeline
cards.line: Wrote the CI pipeline templates in GitHub Actions that cut median build time from 14 minutes to 6
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It connects a concrete engineering change to a before-and-after measure without making the reader guess what you built.

cards.line: Migrated 60 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on EKS over nine months with no customer-facing downtime
cards.cannot_tell: For a manager role, a recruiter will also look for decisions about team direction. If you made one during this migration, bring it into the story.
cards.example: Migrated 60 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on EKS over nine months with no customer-facing downtime; [a decision you made about team direction]
cards.question: What decision, if any, did you make about the team's direction during the migration?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Platform, payment failover
cards.line: Led the payment provider failover project with the payments team, cutting failed checkouts during provider outages from 3.1% to 0.4%
cards.cannot_tell: Move this above the office activities. It's your strongest payments result and directly relevant to Cobalt Pay.

fit.why: Your headline and current role name senior engineering, and your Tidewater work covers platform and payments systems.
fit.level: senior, leads engineering projects with no direct reports shown
fit.note: Your on-call handbook and incident reviews also connect to the team's operations; bring that work forward alongside payments. The role is in Seattle or remote in the US.
